# =============================================================================
# GitHub Actions Workflow: ML Model CI/CD Pipeline
# =============================================================================
# This is an EXAMPLE workflow file (saved as .txt for portfolio demonstration).
# Rename to .yml and place in .github/workflows/ of your repository to activate.
#
# Triggers:
#   - Push to main or feature branches
#   - Pull requests targeting main
#   - Manual dispatch (workflow_dispatch)
#
# Stages:
#   1. Lint & static analysis
#   2. Data validation tests
#   3. Model training
#   4. Model evaluation & regression tests
#   5. A/B test (on PRs)
#   6. Build Docker image
#   7. Canary deployment (on main)
#   8. Promote to production (manual gate)
# =============================================================================

name: ML Model CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, "feature/**"]
    paths:
      - "src/**"
      - "models/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - "requirements*.txt"
      - "Dockerfile"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      force_retrain:
        description: "Force model retraining"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      deploy_target:
        description: "Deployment target"
        type: choice
        options:
          - staging
          - production

env:
  PYTHON_VERSION: "3.11"
  DOCKER_REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}/ml-model-api

jobs:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 1: Code Quality
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  lint:
    name: Lint & Static Analysis
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements*.txt') }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install flake8 black isort mypy

      - name: Run flake8
        run: flake8 src/ tests/ --max-line-length 120

      - name: Check formatting (black)
        run: black --check src/ tests/

      - name: Check import order (isort)
        run: isort --check-only src/ tests/

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 2: Data Validation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  data-validation:
    name: Data Validation Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run data validation tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/test_data_validation.py -v --tb=short
        env:
          DATA_PATH: data/

      - name: Upload data validation report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: data-validation-report
          path: reports/data_validation.json

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 3: Model Training
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  train:
    name: Train Model
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: data-validation
    outputs:
      model_version: ${{ steps.train.outputs.model_version }}
      model_hash: ${{ steps.train.outputs.model_hash }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Train model
        id: train
        run: |
          python train.py --output models/ --algorithm random_forest --seed 42
          MODEL_HASH=$(python -c "import json; m=json.load(open('models/metadata.json')); print(m['model_hash'])")
          echo "model_version=v$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "model_hash=${MODEL_HASH}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload model artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: trained-model
          path: |
            models/model.pkl
            models/metadata.json

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 4: Model Evaluation & Regression Tests
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  evaluate:
    name: Model Evaluation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: train
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Download model artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: trained-model
          path: models/

      - name: Run model performance tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/test_model_performance.py -v --tb=short \
            --junitxml=reports/model_tests.xml

      - name: Run regression tests against baseline
        run: |
          python -m pytest tests/test_regression.py -v --tb=short

      - name: Upload test reports
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: test-reports
          path: reports/

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 5: A/B Test (PRs only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ab-test:
    name: A/B Test vs Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: evaluate
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ env.PYTHON_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Download candidate model
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: trained-model
          path: models/candidate/

      - name: Run A/B test
        run: |
          python ci_cd_pipeline.py --mode ab-test \
            --model-a models/production/model.pkl \
            --model-b models/candidate/model.pkl

      - name: Comment PR with A/B results
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const report = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('reports/ab_test.json'));
            const body = `## A/B Test Results
            | Metric | Production | Candidate |
            |--------|-----------|-----------|
            | Accuracy | ${report.model_a.accuracy} | ${report.model_b.accuracy} |
            | F1 Macro | ${report.model_a.f1_macro} | ${report.model_b.f1_macro} |

            **Winner**: ${report.winner}
            **Statistically Significant**: ${report.statistically_significant}`;

            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: body
            });

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 6: Build Docker Image
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  build-image:
    name: Build Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: evaluate
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download model artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: trained-model
          path: models/

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: |
            ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ needs.train.outputs.model_hash }}
            ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:latest
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 7: Canary Deployment
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  canary-deploy:
    name: Canary Deployment
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-image
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy canary (5% traffic)
        run: |
          echo "Deploying canary with 5% traffic..."
          # kubectl set image deployment/ml-api ml-api=$IMAGE:$TAG
          # kubectl scale --replicas=1 deployment/ml-api-canary

      - name: Wait and monitor canary
        run: |
          echo "Monitoring canary for 5 minutes..."
          sleep 10  # In production: sleep 300 and check metrics

      - name: Check canary health
        run: |
          echo "Checking canary health metrics..."
          # curl -sf http://canary-endpoint/health || exit 1

      - name: Promote canary to 100%
        run: |
          echo "Canary healthy. Promoting to full deployment..."
          # kubectl set image deployment/ml-api ml-api=$IMAGE:$TAG

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Job 8: Production Promotion (manual gate)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  promote-production:
    name: Promote to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: canary-deploy
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: production  # Requires manual approval in GitHub
    steps:
      - name: Promote to production
        run: |
          echo "Promoting model ${{ needs.train.outputs.model_version }} to production"
          # Update model registry
          # Update production deployment
          # Notify team via Slack/email

      - name: Verify production health
        run: |
          echo "Verifying production health..."
          # curl -sf http://production-endpoint/health || exit 1

      - name: Update model registry
        run: |
          echo "Updating model registry with production tag"
          # python update_registry.py --model-id $MODEL_VERSION --stage production
